name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

urlPath.description:
The url path defining the route.

Requirements:
- Must NOT end with `/`, exception for root route
- Can contain route variables, denoted by a variable identifier surrounded by `{{` and `}}` characters.

Examples:
- `/home`
- `facilities/{{facilityId}}/edit`
- `/` (i.e. the "default" or "root" route)

targetModuleName.description:
The UI module to which the {@link targetPageName} belongs. When concatenated with {@link targetPageName}, this
forms the component's metadata id, e.g. `'MyApp.HomePage'`.
PascalCase format is recommended with no dashes.

targetPageName.description:
The name of the {@link UIViewPage} or {@link UIReactPage} to which the url leads. When concatenated with
{@link targetModuleName}, this forms the component's metadata id, e.g. `'MyApp.HomePage'`.
PascalCase format is recommended with no dashes.

targetPageId.description:
The component's metadata id, e.g. `'MyApp.HomePage'`.
Note: we are using a token of two hyphens so that a user may enter a `targetPageName` value with
empty spaces or hyphens (it's extremely unlikely they would have a page name with two hyphens).
We need to be able to convert back and forth between the targetPageId and the targetPageName, because
when we create a new route for a page, we force a page name that is derived from the page id.

role.description: The {@link Role} that is required to access this route. If not specified, the route is accessible to all users.

inAppDoc.description:
The name of the document you'd like to be able to open at this route.
For example, to show `example-document.c3doc.md`, the `inAppDoc` would be `example-document`.

pageTitle.description: Tha page title defined in the component page configuration.

title: UiSdlRouteWithTitle defines a route {@link UiSdlRoute} and adds a pageTitle field to be used in the UI.
name: UiSdlRouteWithTitle
